operations.description: Copy a file or folder; copies get new ids and revs (POST /2/files/copy_v2). Requires scope files.content.write.
Create a folder and any missing parents (POST /2/files/create_folder_v2). Requires scope files.content.write.
Delete a file or folder (with its subtree); deleted entries stay restorable (POST /2/files/delete_v2). Requires scope files.content.write.
Download a file (or one of its revisions). The REST route returns the bytes with metadata in Dropbox-API-Result (POST /2/files/download). Requires scope files.content.read.
Metadata of a file or folder by path, id: or rev: (POST /2/files/get_metadata). Requires scope files.metadata.read.
List a folder (root is ""), optionally recursive and with deleted entries, sorted by path_lower (POST /2/files/list_folder). Requires scope files.metadata.read.
Next page of a listing; after the last page the same cursor returns the changes since the listing (POST /2/files/list_folder/continue). Requires scope files.metadata.read.
A cursor positioned after the current state of a folder, for change polling (POST /2/files/list_folder/get_latest_cursor). Requires scope files.metadata.read.
Revisions of a file, newest first; works for deleted files (POST /2/files/list_revisions). Requires scope files.content.read.
Move or rename a file or folder; ids and revs are kept (POST /2/files/move_v2). Requires scope files.content.write.
Restore a file to an earlier revision as a new revision (POST /2/files/restore). Requires scope files.content.write.
Search names and text content (POST /2/files/search_v2). Requires scope files.metadata.read.
Next page of a search (POST /2/files/search/continue_v2). Requires scope files.metadata.read.
Upload UTF-8 text content (POST /2/files/upload; arguments in Dropbox-API-Arg, content in the body). Requires scope files.content.write.
Create a shared link record for a file or folder (POST /2/sharing/create_shared_link_with_settings). The URL is synthetic and never served. Requires scope sharing.write.
List the account's shared links, all or for one path (POST /2/sharing/list_shared_links). Requires scope sharing.read.
Revoke a shared link by URL (POST /2/sharing/revoke_shared_link; the REST body is null). Requires scope sharing.write.
Get the calling account (POST /2/users/get_current_account). The canonical value also carries server_time (virtual now); the REST route omits it. Requires scope account_info.read.
Space used by live files and the individual allocation (POST /2/users/get_space_usage). Requires scope account_info.read.
